name: Hexahedral Mesh Traversal (Plücker Space)
definition: A traversal method for hexahedral meshes using Plücker tests to determine the exit face, requiring face decomposition into triangles for interpolation.
summary: Hexahedral Mesh Traversal in Plücker Space determines ray exit faces using Plücker coordinates and triangular decomposition, distinguishing itself by enabling unambiguous face selection at the cost of parametric discontinuities.
